limitations: This is a single-run product baseline. Release reliability requires the separately configured repeated-run stability evaluation.
Gold SQL and Gold results are evaluation-only artifacts and are not available to runtime prompts, retrieval, or semantic assets.
Arabic labels and source categorical values remain subject to customer review.
